meta.name: flowio
meta.description: Read, inspect, and write Flow Cytometry Standard (FCS) 2.0, 3.0, and 3.1 files with FlowIO. Use for low-level FCS metadata and channel inspection, NumPy event extraction, multi-dataset files, table export, and FCS 3.1 creation; use FlowKit for compensation, cytometry transforms, gating, or FlowJo workspaces.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 读取解析流式细胞术标准数据文件并支持生成
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果需要处理流式细胞术实验的 FCS 数据文件
copy.tagline_en: Read, inspect, and create Flow Cytometry Standard data files
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you work with FCS files from flow cytometry experiments

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 能读取 FCS 2.0/3.0/3.1 文件,提取元数据与通道信息,把事件导出为 NumPy 数组;也能根据 NumPy 数据新建 FCS 3.1 文件,或转成 CSV/DataFrame。
howto.when: 当你提供 .fcs 文件,想要读取元数据或通道信息、把事件导出成表格,或生成新的 FCS 文件时触发。

say.text: 读取这个 fcs 文件,告诉我版本、事件数和通道名。
say.note: 它会列出文件基本信息。

say.text: 把这个 fcs 的事件数据导出成 CSV。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can read FCS 2.0/3.0/3.1 files, extract metadata and channel information, turn event data into NumPy arrays, create FCS 3.1 files from NumPy data, and export event tables to CSV or DataFrame.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you provide an .fcs file and ask to read its metadata or channels, export event data, or generate a new FCS file.

say_en.text: Read this fcs file and tell me its version, event count, and channel names.
Export the events from this fcs to CSV.
Create an FCS 3.1 file from this NumPy data with channels FSC-A and SSC-A.
say_en.note: Uses create_fcs to write a file.
